def solve_n_queens(n):
    # Using backtracking with constraint propagation
    cols = set()
    diag1 = set()  # r + c
    diag2 = set()  # r - c
    
    solution = [-1] * n
    
    def backtrack(r):
        if r == n:
            return True
        for c in range(n):
            if c in cols or (r + c) in diag1 or (r - c) in diag2:
                continue
            cols.add(c)
            diag1.add(r + c)
            diag2.add(r - c)
            solution[r] = c
            if backtrack(r + 1):
                return True
            cols.remove(c)
            diag1.remove(r + c)
            diag2.remove(r - c)
            solution[r] = -1
        return False
    
    if backtrack(0):
        return solution
    return None
